metadata.title: Chip Stocks Are Falling. Anthropic’s Trillion-Dollar IPO Is a Big Test.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Chip Stocks Are Falling. Anthropic’s Trillion-Dollar IPO Is a Big Test.
These are tough times for chip stocks—and Anthropic’s upcoming IPO will test whether enthusiasm for artificial intelligence can revive the sector.
